info.name: Food Paddi API - Complete Endpoint Collection
info.description: Generated from the uploaded update-of-paddi-main source. Includes all routes mounted by src/server.ts, direct server operations, the Paystack webhook, and routers implemented in source but not mounted by the current server entrypoint. Replace placeholder IDs/tokens/files with values from your environment.
